title: Information Technology Hardware Technician
description:
**Company Description** 
 At Nallam Digitals, we deliver tailored information technology services that address the specific needs of modern enterprises. Our core expertise includes cybersecurity, system optimization, and cloud integration, helping organizations operate efficiently and securely. We focus on building long\-term partnerships by providing reliable support and robust technical solutions. Applicants joining Nallam Digitals can expect to work with an experienced team that values professionalism, continuous improvement, and technical excellence.
 



  





**Job Summary** 





 We are looking for a skilled and responsible IT Hardware Technician to handle computer hardware, networking, operating system, and software\-related technical issues. The candidate should be capable of diagnosing and resolving both routine and critical hardware and software problems efficiently.
 




  





**Role Description** 
 The Information Technology Hardware Technician is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Hyderabad. This role is responsible for installing, configuring, and maintaining desktops, laptops, servers, and peripheral devices such as printers, routers, and switches. The technician will diagnose and resolve hardware issues, replace faulty components, and perform routine preventive maintenance to reduce downtime. Daily tasks include responding to support requests, documenting hardware configurations and repairs, coordinating with vendors for hardware procurement and warranty services, and ensuring that all equipment complies with company security and performance standards. The role may also involve assisting with hardware upgrades for system optimization and supporting project rollouts across the organization.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Strong knowledge of computer hardware components, peripherals, and basic networking devices (desktops, laptops, printers, routers, switches).
* Experience with hardware installation, configuration, troubleshooting, and preventive maintenance in an enterprise or small business environment.
* Familiarity with operating systems (Windows, Linux), basic system setup, and hardware\-related OS configuration tasks.
* Ability to diagnose issues using hardware diagnostic tools and interpret logs or error codes to identify root causes.
* Understanding of safe handling practices for electronic components and adherence to IT security and data protection guidelines.
* Effective communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues in clear, accessible language to non\-technical users.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple on\-site support requests.
* Relevant technical certification (such as CompTIA A\+, hardware\-focused diploma, or equivalent) is preferred.
* Previous experience in an IT support or hardware technician role, particularly within a corporate or service\-provider environment, is an advantage.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 





 \* Diagnose and repair desktop computers, laptops, printers, and other IT hardware.
 





 \* Troubleshoot critical hardware issues, including motherboard, RAM, hard disk/SSD, power supply, display, and peripheral problems.
 





 \* Install, configure, and maintain Windows operating systems and required software.
 





 \* Troubleshoot software errors, application issues, driver problems, and system performance issues.
 





 \* Perform hardware upgrades, replacements, and preventive maintenance.
 





 \* Troubleshoot basic LAN, Wi\-Fi, internet, and networking\-related issues.
 





 \* Install and configure printers, scanners, and other peripherals.
 





 \* Perform data backup, system formatting, OS installation, and software configuration when required.
 





 \* Identify the root cause of recurring technical problems and implement suitable solutions.
 





 \* Maintain records of hardware, software, repairs, replacements, and service activities.
 





 \* Provide technical support to employees/users and resolve issues within the required time.
 





 \* Escalate issues to senior technical teams or vendors when necessary.
 




  





**Required Skills** 





 \* Strong knowledge of computer hardware and troubleshooting.
 





 \* Good knowledge of Windows operating systems and software troubleshooting.
 





 \* Ability to diagnose and resolve critical hardware failures.
 





 \* Knowledge of hardware installation, replacement, and maintenance.
 





 \* Good problem\-solving and analytical skills.
 





 \* Ability to work independently and handle multiple technical issues.
 





 \* Good communication and customer/user\-support skills.
 




  





**Educational Qualification** 





 \* Diploma / ITI /
 
 B.Tech
 
 / B.E. /
 
 B.Sc
 
 . / BCA / relevant technical qualification in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, or a related field.
 




  





**Preferred Experience** 





 \* 1–3 years of experience in IT hardware support or technical support is preferred.
 





 \* Freshers with strong practical hardware troubleshooting knowledge may also be considered.
 




  





**Additional Requirements** 





 \* Willingness to handle urgent and critical technical issues.
 





 \* Willingness to travel to client/branch locations if required.
 





 \* Valid driving licence would be an advantage, if field support is part of the role.
 




  





**Key Performance Expectations** 




*The selected candidate will be expected to:* 





 \* Resolve hardware and software issues efficiently.
 





 \* Minimize system downtime.
 





 \* Maintain proper documentation of technical issues and solutions.
 





 \* Ensure IT equipment is maintained properly and remains operational.
 





 \* Provide professional and timely technical support to users.

title: Tier 1 Support Analyst - Aftersales
description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**
 We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.
   

  

 We use cutting\-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience.
 **Want to be part of it?**
**Purpose of the Role**
 Provision of an excellent support service is critical to the achievement of Keyloop’s strategic plans for growth and profitability. Our Tier 1 Support Analyst will primarily be responsible for owning, troubleshooting, diagnosing and resolving problems to successful closure, whilst ensuring timely escalation where necessary.
   

  

 They will also assist colleagues and will not only have outstanding verbal and written communication skills but can demonstrate that they are able to communicate quickly and efficiently at all levels across a Global team (customer, peers, and managers) in order to achieve our departmental and company strategy.
   

  

 This role requires someone who is resourceful and well organised, with excellent analytical and problem solving skills, who is able to work effectively as part of a high performing team with a passion and commitment to providing service excellence
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Provide support for Parts and Service processes, including inventory, pricing, stock updates, workshop scheduling, repair orders and related dealership operations
* Log, prioritise, investigate and manage assigned support cases from receipt through to resolution, workaround or escalation
* Gather and document clear diagnostic information, including user impact, steps taken, expected and actual outcomes, errors and relevant evidence
* Investigate system configuration, data, access, process, interface and product\-related issues using available support tools, case history and knowledge resources
* Provide practical customer guidance in clear, user\-friendly language and keep customers informed throughout the case lifecycle
* Support approved third\-party, OEM and partner integrations by reviewing transactions, interface failures, file transfers, alerts and exceptions where required
* Co\-ordinate with customers, third parties and internal teams to progress complex or high\-impact issues, ensuring escalations are clear, evidence\-based and timely
* Assist with approved price\-file imports, stock\-file updates and validation, while ensuring customer approval, accurate records and risk escalation where needed
* Maintain structured case notes, confirm outcomes with customers before closure and record reusable resolution details to support future knowledge sharing
* Contribute to case reduction initiatives by identifying opportunities within the customer base and promoting improvements within support teams


**Skills, Knowledge \& Experience**
* Understanding and familiarity with stock management processes or the automotive industry
* Ability to efficiently plan and prioritise workload to meet deadlines
* Expertise or knowledge relating to a specified Keyloop product or module
* High level of investigation, analytical, problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
* Knowledge and understanding of customer expectations
* Ability to influence, overcome objections and de\-escalate potentially critical customer situations
* Ability to interact with multiple levels of Keyloop customers and internal partners
* Ability to explain complex problems, issues and accounting concepts in simple terms
* Experience in dealing with customers across a variety of channels with a high level of professionalism


**Why join us?**
 We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space \- and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game\-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.
   

  

**An inclusive environment to thrive**
 We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles \- not just on key days, but every day.
   

  

**Be rewarded for your efforts**
 We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.
   

  

 Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.
   

  

**We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply**

description:
**Application Support Engineer – Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS/LIS)**

 Providence Global Center

 5–8 Years
   

  

**Location:** 
 \[Hyderabad / Office]
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**About The Role**
 Providence Global Center is seeking a skilled Application Support Engineer with experience in Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS/LIS) to support day\-to\-day operations, system maintenance, and integrations. This role will work closely with SMEs and senior engineers while also independently handling incidents, troubleshooting, and system enhancements.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Application Support \& Operations**
* Provide L2/L3 support for LIS/LIMS applications in on\-premises and Azure Cloud environments.
* Monitor system performance and ensure high availability of applications.
* Independently troubleshoot and resolve incidents within defined SLAs.


**Laboratory Workflow \& Integration Support**
* Support end\-to\-end laboratory workflows including order entry, processing, and result reporting.
* Assist in maintaining integrations between lab instruments, middleware, LIS, and EHR systems.
* Work with HL7 interfaces to monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve data flow issues.


**Clinical Coding \& Mapping**
* Work with clinical coding systems such as LOINC, SNOMED, ICD, and CPT.
* Troubleshoot issues related to code mapping, test catalog configuration, and data discrepancies.
* Support accurate and consistent data exchange across systems.


**Incident, Problem \& Change Management**
* Handle service tickets, incidents, and service requests efficiently.
* Support root cause analysis (RCA) and problem management initiatives.
* Participate in change management activities including deployments and upgrades.


**System Maintenance \& Enhancements**
* Perform routine system maintenance, patching support, and application upgrades.
* Assist in environment validation and post\-deployment verification.
* Document configurations, procedures, and troubleshooting steps.


**Collaboration \& Continuous Improvement**
* Work closely with SMEs, developers, vendors, and cross\-functional teams.
* Contribute to knowledge base articles and SOP documentation.
* Identify opportunities for process improvements and automation.


**Required Qualifications**
* 5–8 years of experience in application support, preferably in LIS/LIMS environments.
* Good understanding of laboratory workflows and clinical systems.
* Hands\-on experience with clinical coding standards: LOINC, SNOMED, ICD, and CPT.
* Experience troubleshooting code mapping and interface issues.
* Working knowledge of HL7 messaging and interface support.
* Experience supporting integrations (lab instruments, middleware, LIS, EHR).
* Exposure to Azure Cloud and/or on\-prem infrastructure environments.
* Understanding of ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Change Management).
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage priorities effectively.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in healthcare or clinical laboratory domain.
* Basic scripting or automation knowledge is a plus.
* Certifications in ITIL, Azure, or related technologies.

title: Associate Support Engineer - Salesforce
description:
**CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER.** 
 It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire fans, entertain audiences and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.
   

  

**Overview**
 We are seeking an Associate Software Engineer for our Salesforce Salesforce Developer to provide expert\-level support for our Salesforce Consumer Goods (CG) Cloud platform, with a particular focus on Trade Promotion Management and Key Account Management modules. In this support\-focused role, you will ensure the ongoing smooth operation, troubleshooting, and optimization of the TPM \& KAM application. This role reports to the application lead.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Provide hands\-on development support for incident resolution, break\-fix efforts, and system enhancements related to the Salesforce TPM \& KAM application.
* Analyze and troubleshoot issues reported by global business teams, delivering timely resolutions in line with SLA requirements.
* Act as the primary point of contact for escalated support tickets and investigate and resolve issues related to TPM \& KAM functionality.
* Collaborate with business analysts and global stakeholders to gather, clarify, and refine requirements for new features or process improvements.
* Participate in the full development lifecycle, including estimation, technical design, development, code reviews, testing, deployment, and post\-deployment support.
* Perform system maintenance activities such as routine updates, patches, and configuration changes to ensure seamless application performance.
* Monitor and evaluate system performance, identifying issues and opportunities for optimization and long\-term stability.
* Troubleshoot and resolve data integrity issues, working with cross\-functional teams to identify root causes and implement corrective actions.
* Support and troubleshoot integrations with external systems (e.g., ERP, TPM tools, analytics platforms) related to the TPP application.
* Stay up to date with Salesforce releases, applying relevant updates and patches to maintain system currency.
* Document support processes, known issues, and solutions in the knowledge base for training and reference purposes.


**Skills \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 1\-2 years of experience in Salesforce administration, support, or architecture, with a strong focus on Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud and Trade Promotion Management (TPM).
* Proven experience in supporting TPM/TPP processes such as promotion execution, fund management, claim management, and performance evaluation within the Consumer Goods industry.
* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce Field Service, Einstein Analytics, MuleSoft, and Salesforce integration tools (including API management and data integration).
* Knowledge of Salesforce data models, security models, and process automation.
* Experience managing support tickets and working with cross\-functional teams to resolve production issues quickly.
* Ability to perform detailed root cause analysis and deliver actionable solutions in a timely manner.
* Ability to review and support Apex based customizations in collaboration with the development team.
* Knowledge of declarative automation tools such as Flows, validation rules, and approval processes to support and optimize TPM business processes.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Salesforce certifications such as Salesforce Certified Administrator, Consumer Goods Cloud Accredited Professional, or Sales Cloud Consultant are preferred.

You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

 We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors
   

  

* We collaborate Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.

Combining purposeful in\-person collaboration with flexibility, our focus is to optimize performance and drive connection for moments that matter.

title: QSC Q-Sys Operations Remote Support Engineer - APAC
description:
**WHO WE ARE:**
 EOS IT Solutions is a Global Technology and Logistics company, providing Collaboration and Business IT Support services to some of the world’s largest industry leaders, delivering forward\-thinking solutions based on multi\-domain architecture. Customer satisfaction and commitment to superior quality of service are our top business priorities, along with investing in and supporting our partners and employees.
   

  

 We are a true International IT provider and are proud to deliver our services through global simplicity with trusted transparency.
   

  

**POSITION OVERVIEW:**
 We are seeking an Infrastructure Engineer to join our Audiovisual Engineering team. This technical role supports the global AV ecosystem that powers seamless communication and collaboration across the company. You’ll be responsible for the implementation, support, administration, and life cycle management of audio/video hardware and software, focusing not only on reliability, but also on automation, scripting, and operational scalability. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience with commercial AV technologies (QSC Q\-SYS, Shure, Dante), video conferencing systems (Google Meet, Zoom), and converged IP networks, paired with a strong foundation in automation tools, programming, and infrastructure as code. You’ll play a key role in driving innovation, improving support processes, and building repeatable solutions that reduce manual overhead. This position involves full lifecycle project ownership—from requirements gathering and design reviews through deployment and operational support—and may require occasional off\-hours work.
   

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**
* Own the implementation and support of AV technologies for deployment projects globally.
* Work closely with architects, engineers, and AV integrators to design, automate, and deploy solutions that align with company standards.
* Develop and manage scripts, tools, and automation pipelines for provisioning and managing AV systems.
* Analyze, test, install, document, and support audio/video over IP solutions in a global, converged network environment.
* Create and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to support AV operations and upgrades in production.
* Produce scopes of work, documentation (including AV schematics), and vendor communications for new AV installations or retrofits.
* Identify and recommend new technologies or automation strategies to improve scalability and efficiency.
* Maintain detailed documentation of deployed AV configurations, including change history and versioning.
* Lead or assist in root cause analysis and long\-term resolution of AV issues; mentor junior engineers in troubleshooting and automation techniques.
* Develop and manage project timelines, resource estimates, and product refresh schedules.
* Serve as Tier 3 support for complex AV issues and escalations in production environments.
* Travel up to 20% for deployments, testing, and operational support.


**WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO SUCCEED:**
* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* QSC Q\-SYS certification, strong remote support experience
* 4\+ years in a corporate IT or AV integration environment, with at least 3 years working directly with commercial AV systems.
* Proficient in supporting video conferencing platforms such as Google Meet, Zoom, Logitech, and Neat.
* Programming and automation experience (e.g., Python, Ansible, PowerShell) to build tools and automate repetitive AV tasks.
* Strong understanding of AV over IP technologies and networking fundamentals.
* Experience with AV control system logic and user interface design is a plus.
* Comfortable adapting to change and working in fast\-paced, evolving environments.
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills, with attention to detail and a proactive mindset.
* Skilled in breaking down complex issues into actionable solutions.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills; capable of translating technical concepts for diverse audiences.
* Self\-starter with a passion for innovation, automation, and continuous improvement.
* Bonus: Experience supporting live production events or hybrid broadcast\-style setups.


*EOS is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We invite you to consider opportunities at EOS regardless of your gender; gender identity; gender reassignment; age; religious or similar philosophical belief; race; national origin; political opinion; sexual orientation; disability; marital or civil partnership status or other non\-merit factor.*

title: Junior Field Applications Engineer, ASIC Design
description:
Alternate Job Titles
   

  

* Application Engineer, Physical Design
* Associate Applications Engineer, Silicon Design
* Junior Field Applications Engineer, ASIC Design
* Technical Support Engineer, Physical Design
* Applications Engineer, Digital Implementation


 We Are
   

  

 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
   

  

 You Are
   

  

 You are early in your career but already know that the most interesting problems in chip design are not the ones in the textbook, they are the ones that show up when a customer is three weeks from tapeout and their timing is not closing. You have spent time in internships or academic projects working with ASIC flows, and you learned that understanding the theory is only half the job. The other half is figuring out what went wrong, why the tool did what it did, and how to explain it clearly enough that the person on the other end of the call can actually fix it.
   

  

 You are curious. When something breaks, you do not just escalate it, you dig in. You look at the logs, reproduce the issue, and try to understand the root cause before asking for help. You are comfortable learning new tools and flows without perfect documentation because you know how to read through examples, ask smart questions, and connect the dots. At Synopsys, you will work directly with customers and internal teams on real chip design challenges, learning from experienced engineers while solving problems that matter. This is where you build the foundation that turns you into the engineer customers call when things get hard.
   

  

 What You'll Be Doing
   

  

* Provide technical support to customers using Synopsys Physical Design tools, helping them resolve issues in their ASIC development flows
* Diagnose and troubleshoot customer problems by analyzing design data, tool logs, and flow configurations to isolate root causes
* Work closely with internal product engineering and R\&D teams to reproduce issues, suggest workarounds, and escalate bugs that need fixes
* Respond to customer requests during critical design schedules, providing timely solutions or workarounds that keep projects moving
* Build working knowledge of Synopsys Physical Design tools and methodologies through hands\-on customer engagements and internal training
* Participate in customer deployments and training sessions, helping teams adopt Synopsys tools and best practices
* Document technical issues, solutions, and customer feedback to improve internal knowledge bases and inform product improvements


 The Impact You Will Have
   

  

* Help customers meet their tapeout schedules by resolving technical issues that would otherwise block their progress
* Improve the quality and usability of Synopsys tools by surfacing real customer pain points to product engineering and R\&D
* Build customer confidence in Synopsys solutions by delivering reliable, timely technical support during critical project phases
* Contribute to the development of better methodologies and reference flows based on what you learn from customer deployments
* Accelerate your own technical growth by working on diverse customer designs across different process nodes and design styles
* Strengthen customer relationships by being responsive, thorough, and solution\-oriented even when the problem is not straightforward
* Support the broader Applications Engineering team by taking ownership of support cases and learning to handle more complex issues over time


 What You'll Need
   

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering or related field
* At least 6 months to 1 year of internship or contractor experience in a global or multinational company, ideally in semiconductor or EDA
* Solid understanding of Physical Design flow, including placement, routing, timing, and basic optimization concepts
* Strong foundation in digital circuits, CMOS fundamentals, and ASIC design flow from RTL to GDSII
* Working knowledge of Unix/Linux environments and basic scripting for automation and debugging
* Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to customers and colleagues
* Experience with Synopsys Physical Design tools such as Fusion Compiler, IC Compiler II, PrimeTime, or StarRC is a plus but not required


 Who You Are
   

  

* You can take a vague customer description like "the tool is crashing" and turn it into a specific reproducer with logs and data
* Comfortable asking questions when you do not know something, but you also try to figure it out yourself first
* You stay organized when managing multiple support cases and know which ones need immediate attention versus which can wait
* You do not get frustrated when the answer is not obvious, you treat it as a puzzle worth solving
* Reliable enough that when you say you will follow up with a customer by end of day, it actually happens
* Open to domestic and international travel for customer visits, training, and onsite support when needed


 The Team You'll Be Part Of
   

  

 You will join the Silicon Design \& Verification Applications Engineering team, working with experienced engineers who support customers on Physical Design flows and tools. This team collaborates closely with R\&D, product engineering, and global AE teams to solve customer problems and improve Synopsys solutions. Your recruiter will share more about team structure, mentorship, and growth opportunities during the interview process.
   

  

 Rewards and Benefits
   

  

 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

title: IT Support Specialist, Senior
description:
**Department:** 
 Information Technology
   

  

**Location:** 
 Hyderabad
   

  

**Description**
 We are seeking an experienced IT Support Specialist – Senior to lead high\-quality end\-user support, hardware troubleshooting, and application assistance across Windows, Linux, and macOS platforms. Beyond hands\-on resolution, this role owns AV operations governance, mentors junior support staff, drives process and automation improvements across the end user onsite support and service desk, and works closely with internal teams and vendors to ensure seamless, scalable IT service delivery and continuous improvement mindset.
   

  

**A Typical Day In The Life Includes**
**End\-User \& IT Support:**
* Provide Level 2/3 support for laptops (hardware diagnostics, replacements, vendor coordination) and act as the escalation point for complex or repeat issues.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues across Windows, Linux (Ubuntu), and macOS, mentor junior technicians on advanced diagnostics.
* Managed imaging, OS deployment, software installation, driver updates, and post\-deployment validation.
* Coordinated with imaging, networking, and security teams to ensure smooth migration
* Support internal and SaaS\-based applications, including email, VPNs, printers, and network connectivity.
* Own and continuously improve IT ticketing workflows to track incidents and service requests, identifying recurring issues for permanent fixes.
* Build and maintain documentation, SOPs, and troubleshooting playbooks; review and standardize documentation created by junior team members.
* Lead workstation visits for physical connectivity or issue diagnosis and act as senior point of contact for new hire setup (monitors and other asset installation).


**Gen AI \& Automation for End\-User Support and Service Desk Operations**
* Identify repetitive, high\-volume ticket categories (password resets, access requests, standard hardware issues) and design automation or self\-service workflows to reduce manual effort.
* Collaborated with automation teams supporting infrastructure automation initiatives
* Proven hands\-on experience in Automation on service improvements and volume reduction.
* Evaluate and pilot Gen AI\-powered tools (AI chatbots, virtual agents, knowledge\-based copilots) for L1/L2 query deflection and faster first\-response times.
* Use Gen AI tools to draft, summarize, and continuously refine SOPs, troubleshooting playbooks, and knowledge base articles from historical ticket data.
* Partner with IT Infrastructure and vendors to implement automated asset lifecycle workflows (auto\-provisioning, auto\-ticket routing, auto\-CMDB updates) to reduce manual tracking errors.
* Analyse ticket trends and service desk metrics using AI/analytics tools to proactively flag recurring problems and recommend root\-cause fixes.
* Automated routine administrative activities using PowerShell, Workflows and AI Tools


**IT Hardware Asset Lifecycle Management, Audits and Compliance**
* Own the full lifecycle of IT hardware assets from request, procurement, deployment, refresh, return, and disposal.
* Ensure all assets are accurately recorded and maintained in the CMDB/Asset Management System, drive data accuracy audits.
* Track ownership, location, warranty, lifecycle status, and asset tags.
* Drive inventory hygiene, OOW disposal, and laptop readiness tracking; manage spare inventory with 100% matching on procurement versus allocation.
* Lead periodic physical and system\-based asset audits and report on compliance gaps.
* Ensure PC refresh activities follow policy, and CMDB records remain accurate.


**Audio\-Visual (AV) Support**
* Set up, operate, and troubleshoot AV equipment for meetings and events, including complex or executive\-level setups, Tow\-Halls setup and Management.
* Support audio systems, microphones, and video conferencing solutions; troubleshoot escalations from junior AV support staff.
* Ensure flawless AV execution for in\-person and virtual events, including contingency planning for critical meetings.


**Collaboration \& Vendor Management**
* Work closely with IT Infrastructure, AV, Security, and Facilities teams on cross\-functional initiatives, representing the service desk in planning discussions.
* Coordinate with and manage third\-party vendors for warranty claims, service fulfilment, and SLA adherence.
* Ensure hardware call logs are placed on time with no impact to users; own BAU continuity for the support function.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree (B.Sc., B.Tech.) or diploma in Computer Science, Electronics, AV, or related fields.
* 10–12 years of hands\-on IT support experience across multi\-OS environments, including experience mentoring or leading junior support staff.
* Proficient in troubleshooting Windows, macOS, and Linux (Mandatory Requirement).
* Experience in Windows, macOS, Office 365, Active Directory, and endpoint management tools (e.g., Intune, SCCM, JAMF).
* Experience of networking fundamentals and remote access technologies (VPN, VDI, etc.).
* Strong working knowledge of Active Directory, remote support tools, and endpoint security practices.
* Hands\-on experience implementing Gen AI or automation tools (chatbots, RPA, workflow automation) within an IT support or service desk environment.
* Excellent analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills; ability to guide and coach junior team members.
* 5 Days Work from Office in a Week (No work from home option).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Certifications: Apple ACSP, ITIL Foundation/Intermediate is a plus.
* Experience supporting hybrid (remote \+ in\-office) workforce environments.
* Familiarity with ITIL processes, asset management tools, and service desk automation/AI platforms (e.g., ServiceNow AI, Microsoft Copilot, chatbot tools).
* Hands on experience in PowerShell or Python
* Agile/Lean experience in support operations or continuous improvement initiatives.

 Seismic is the Go\-To\-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer\-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. **Overview:**
 We are looking for a talented and driven Implementation Engineer to join our Professional Services team. In this role, you will design and implement integration solutions, collaborating closely with product and engineering teams to deliver tailored solutions for our enterprise clients. You will serve as the subject matter expert on Seismic’s platform components, working alongside customers, project managers, solution consultants, and teams across different geographies to deliver seamless automations, custom solutions, and integrations.
   

  

**Who you are:**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Two or more years of experience in Enterprise Content Professional Services.
* one or more years of hands\-on experience designing, implementing, and testing API integrations and solutions, with above average knowledge of RESTful APIs.
* Strong knowledge of SQL, Web Service Consumption, SOQL, and Salesforce Reporting.
* Expert knowledge of Excel Model, SSO, SMTP, SCIM and Salesforce Setup.
* Expert knowledge of LiveDoc \& LiveForm is preferred.
* Ability to lead projects with teams located in different geographies.
* Demonstrated experience leading requirements gathering efforts on large\-scale projects.
* Strong written and oral communication skills with a proven ability to initiate and manage relationships with customers at all levels.
* Self\-starter with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Demonstrates strong self\-learning capabilities with the aptitude to quickly grasp new product features, technologies, and concepts.
* Critical thinking, analysis, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving capability.
* Advanced proficiency with the Microsoft Office Suite including PowerPoint, Word, and Excel.
* Understanding of New Product Development Methodologies and Emerging Technologies (Mobile, Security, Internet, etc.).
* Strong facilitation, project management, and organisational skills.
* Strong relationship development and people management skills.
* Experience collaborating with and providing business recommendations to management.
* Comfortable writing and troubleshooting Python code snippets.
* Experience utilising AI tools and building agents to drive efficiency and quality improvement.
* Experience in the Business Requirements Creation Process for a technical product or similar experience.
* Experience with Seismic or another Sales Enablement platform is a plus.
* Experience in Product Management on a Technical Product is a plus.


**What you’ll be doing:**
* Collaborate with business development, product management, and engineering teams to create and deploy integration solutions for complex client needs.
* Lead requirement gathering sessions with enterprise customers to understand business goals, technical requirements, and integration objectives.
* Serve as subject matter expert on Seismic’s platform capabilities, APIs, out\-of\-the\-box offerings, and custom integrations.
* Provide strategic and hands\-on technical guidance to clients throughout the evaluation, implementation, and post\-deployment phases.
* Communicate and present solutions effectively to client executives and technical teams.
* Serve as technical lead across multiple concurrent projects, ensuring timely delivery and high\-quality outcomes in collaboration with cross\-functional teams across different geographies.
* Identify and mitigate risks in technical workstreams, escalating critical issues as needed.
* Develop creative, robust, scalable, and reusable strategies to support evolving business needs.
* Deliver ongoing support and services for existing customers in alignment with SLAs; manage customer escalations while seeking technical resolution.
* Conduct virtual and on\-site training sessions to enable customer success.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to advocate for customer\-driven enhancements and feature requests.
* Seek out new industry and technology trends and apply this knowledge to solve business problems.

title: Consultant - Veeva Safety - Managed Services (Remote)
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission\-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest\-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
   

  

 At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
   

  

 As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
   

  

 Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
   

  

**The Role**
**Managed Services** 
 is provided to our R\&D customers after they go live with Veeva applications. We aim to be our customers' trusted partners and ensure they leverage the additional value Veeva applications offer.
   

  

 Our
 **Managed Services Team** 
 comprises 90\+ consultants in Europe, of which 5\+ are in the Safety Team. Due to the rapid growth of our client portfolio, we are growing our team every year and opening many career opportunities for our new and existing employees. We hire people from industry, tech, and consulting, which adds diversity to our team.
   

  

 Veeva is looking for Drug Safety and Pharmacovigilance consultants to join the Managed Services team and support our Vault Safety solution after implementation.
   

  

**As a Safety Consultant** 
 , you will support a group of biopharmaceutical customers assigned to you. Your task will be to understand their business processes, provide guidance, discuss Vault changes, and apply all the required configurations. You will also actively collaborate with other teams at Veeva, shape ideas, enhance our delivery model, and work closely with our product management team to communicate the customer’s requirements and meet the evolving needs of the industry.
   

  

**To thrive in this role** 
 , you are able to adapt and learn new technology. You have been configuring, supporting, or implementing software solutions. You enjoy working with customers, speak fluent English, and have strong communication and presentation skills. You enjoy working in fast paced environments, are a team player and fast learner .
   

  

 This is a remote, full\-time role with Veeva with occasional travel to the Veeva Hyderabad site.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Help to keep up to date and implement new features within the Veeva Safety suite
* Work closely with customer business and IT staff to understand their requirements
* Think critically to help design the solution your customers request as well as the solution they have not requested but may need
* Act as customer liaison, managing communication between implementation and maintenance teams, customer stakeholders, and internal Veeva Product teams
* Guide customers in adopting Vault and industry best practices as part of post\-implementation programs focused on the holistic success of the customer
* Drive change management methodology for our customers switching from on\-premises to SaaS solutions


**Requirements**
* 5\+ years of life sciences industry experience, with the majority of time spent in the Drug Safety and Pharmacovigilance domain and experience in a consulting function
* Knowledge of Drug Safety and Pharmacovigilance processes and regulations
* Must have a decent experience writing complex SQL queries on safety data sets
* Should have worked on implementing safety systems like Aris / Argus / Emperica / Commonwealth / RxLogix / or any home\-grown safety system
* Proven ability to collaborate with diverse stakeholders and ensure delivery to a high degree of satisfaction
* Good to have experience building aggregate and analytical reports on safety data set
* Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal
* Must have worked in an individual contributor capacity in the previous employments
* Ability to act with speed to understand business requirements, create corresponding solution designs, and willingness to “roll up your sleeves” to design and deliver Vault Safety
* Exposure to life sciences compliance and computer systems validation requirements
* Ability to travel for about : 25% of the project time
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent required
* Has the right attitude and mindset to work towards customer success


****Nice to Have****
* Proven track record supporting high impact global system implementation programs as a consultant, business, or IT lead, and/or business sponsor
* Direct experience with Argus and/or other drug safety applications
* Life science, computer science, or related degree
* SaaS/Cloud experience
* Experience in services delivery management and/or systems implementation
* Locality to major life sciences customer hub (Bangalore, IN; Hyderabad, IN)

**Position Overview**
 Executive Support \& IT Operations provides end\-to\-end L1, L2, and L3 technical support, with a strong focus on Executive/VIP Support. The role supports Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365, Windows and macOS endpoints, Exchange Online, Zoom and Zoom Rooms, Jira Service Management, PagerDuty, and SharePoint. Responsibilities include resolving complex incidents, managing executive devices and technology refreshes, supporting leadership meetings and company events, administering user access and endpoint policies, and improving support operations through documentation, reporting, and PowerShell automation. The engineer also mentors junior team members and collaborates with global IT teams to deliver secure, reliable, and customer\-focused technology services.
   

  

 Position Overview
   

  

 Zelis is seeking an experienced
 **IT Support Engineer** 
 to provide combined
 **L1, L2, and L3 technical support** 
 , with a strong focus on
 **Executive/VIP White Glove Support and IT Operations** 
 .
   

  

 This role will serve as a trusted technology partner for executives, executive assistants, employees, and global IT teams. The engineer will own technical issues from initial intake through resolution while providing proactive, discreet, and highly responsive support across Microsoft technologies, endpoints, collaboration platforms, incidents, events, automation, and service improvement.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Executive and VIP Support
   

  

* Provide personalized, high\-priority technical support for executives, executive assistants, senior leaders, and designated VIP users.
* Manage Jira VIP incidents and service requests, ensuring rapid acknowledgement, clear communication, appropriate escalation, and timely resolution.
* Support executive Windows and macOS devices, Microsoft 365 applications, mobile devices, peripherals, connectivity, and collaboration tools.
* Proactively manage executive device health, including patching, performance checks, security compliance, laptop replacements, warranty reviews, and hardware lifecycle planning.
* Coordinate executive technology replacements, data transfers, application validation, and post\-deployment follow\-up with minimal business disruption.
* Provide onsite support for executive visits, leadership meetings, webinars, and company town halls.
* Handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion while maintaining end\-to\-end ownership of executive escalations.


 L1, L2, and L3 Technical Support
   

  

* Deliver full\-spectrum support covering L1 intake and triage, L2 advanced troubleshooting, and L3 escalation and root\-cause analysis.
* Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, operating system, identity, access, endpoint, application, and connectivity issues.
* Troubleshoot complex Windows and macOS incidents using diagnostic tools, system logs, administrative consoles, and endpoint\-management platforms.
* Own incidents and service requests through closure, coordinating with infrastructure, networking, security, application, and vendor teams when required.
* Document troubleshooting, resolution steps, business impact, and root cause accurately in Jira Service Management.
* Identify recurring issues and implement improvements that increase first\-contact resolution and reduce repeat incidents.


 Microsoft and Endpoint Administration
   

  

* Manage and support Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 environments, including virtual machines, user accounts, groups, identity services, endpoints, and device policies.
* Administer and troubleshoot Exchange Online, including mailboxes, permissions, distribution groups, shared mailboxes, email, and calendar issues.
* Support employee onboarding, access changes, and offboarding in coordination with HR, security, and application owners.
* Manage endpoint configuration, software deployment, patching, compliance, and device health using ManageEngine Endpoint Central and related tools.
* Develop and enforce IT security, endpoint, and operational policies aligned with compliance and enterprise technology standards.


 Zoom and Event Support
   

  

* Administer Zoom Meetings, Zoom Webinars, Zoom Rooms, and Zoom licensing, including scheduling, configuration, troubleshooting, reporting, and account management.
* Perform conference\-room and Zoom Room health checks covering displays, cameras, microphones, controllers, software, licensing, and connectivity.
* Provide rehearsal, presenter, and live\-event support for webinars, executive meetings, leadership sessions, and company town halls.
* Coordinate with executive assistants, communications, facilities, vendors, and global IT teams to ensure successful event delivery.
* Maintain backup technology and contingency plans for high\-visibility meetings and events.


 Incident and Service Management
   

  

* Participate in PagerDuty on\-call incident management, acknowledging, troubleshooting, documenting, and coordinating incidents within defined SLAs.
* Support major incidents by assessing business impact, engaging resolver teams, communicating status, and assisting with service restoration.
* Manage Jira stories, Jira Service Management queues, and Confluence content, ensuring work is prioritized, tracked, and completed.
* Monitor ticket ageing, VIP requests, escalations, SLA risks, and recurring support trends.
* Participate in incident reviews, root\-cause analysis, problem management, and continuous\-improvement initiatives.


 Knowledge, Training, and Zenius Bar Operations
   

  

* Create and maintain Executive Support documentation, knowledge\-base articles, standard operating procedures, and Jira canned responses.
* Deliver new\-hire IT orientation sessions for employees across India and the United States, covering technology setup, access, security, collaboration tools, and support processes.
* Support the Hyderabad Zenius Bar, including ticket monitoring, employee assistance, technician training, survey analysis, and operational reporting.
* Develop and maintain Zenius Bar reporting in SharePoint, providing centralized access to metrics, schedules, documentation, and management reports.
* Promote knowledge sharing, self\-service adoption, and consistent support practices across the organization.


 Automation and Leadership
   

  

* Use PowerShell to automate user administration, device checks, reporting, data collection, and repetitive support activities.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, improve service speed, strengthen reliability, and enhance the employee and executive technology experience.
* Mentor junior engineers and serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues.
* Collaborate with global infrastructure, security, end\-user computing, service desk, networking, and application teams.
* Build strong relationships with executives, employees, and stakeholders through clear communication, accountability, and customer\-focused support.


**Required Qualifications**
* Experience in enterprise IT support, desktop support, end\-user computing, or service\-desk operations.
* Demonstrated experience providing Executive/VIP Support.
* Ability to perform L1, L2, and L3 responsibilities and manage issues through complete resolution.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, identity and access administration, endpoint management, Windows, and macOS.
* Experience supporting Zoom Meetings, Webinars, Zoom Rooms, and conference\-room technology.
* Working knowledge of Jira Service Management, Confluence, PagerDuty, ManageEngine Endpoint Central, SharePoint, and PowerShell.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, work under pressure, exercise sound judgment, and handle confidential information appropriately.
* Ability to provide onsite, on\-call, after\-hours, and event support based on business requirements.
* Bachelor’s degree, technical diploma, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting executives in a global, healthcare, financial\-services, or regulated organization.
* Familiarity with ITIL incident, request, problem, change, and knowledge\-management practices.
* Experience supporting employees and teams across India and the United States.
* Microsoft, Zoom, ITIL, endpoint\-management, Windows, macOS, or related certifications.
* Experience mentoring junior engineers and using operational metrics to improve IT services.


 Core Technologies
   

  

**Microsoft Azure \| Microsoft 365 \| Exchange Online \| ManageEngine Endpoint Central \| Jira Service Management \| Confluence \| Zoom \| Zoom Webinars \| Zoom Rooms \| PagerDuty \| SharePoint \| PowerShell \| Windows \| macOS**

You will be responsible for managing the requirements for any new use cases identified as part of the improvement plan, working with the DEM Business Analyst and DEM Technician to ensure successful delivery of these requirements.

Where there is no Digital Advisor allocated to the account, the role will involve a period of transition to support the baselining and configuration of the digital experience score, based on requirements from the customer and account team, and the initial set of recommendations for improvement areas based on use cases and best practices from the DEM Dojo.
* The role should follow the ITIL Service Value System Principles Focus on value Start where you are Progress iteratively with feedback Collaborate and promote visibility
* Think and work holistically Keep it simple and practical Optimize and automate Success factors Value Decreased incidents and contacts at the service desk through proactive investigation and problem management of end user issues Increased adoption and use of a virtual assistant, by enabling more use cases through the integration of DEM technologies with the virtual agent
* Decreased MTTR of Fujitsu managed services resolver groups by educating them on using DEM technologies to resolve issues and through the implementation of their use case and dashboard requirements
* The exploitation of the DEM technologies to drive account ROI and transformation of roles towards proactive continuous improvement Increased end user digital experience scores tied into outcome\-based CI Successful launch and program activity, minimize delays Meet contractual KSVI commitments Customer renewals / good news stories and references
* Supporting the CI Service Delivery Manager to drive change and improvements Maturity assessment benefits realization / understand customer journey mapping Required

title: Data Centre Linux & HW Engineer, Data Center Operations
description:
**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 Data Center Operations designs, installs \& maintains the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure. We are looking for skilled Data Centre Operation Technician at Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”) with a passion for technology to help us expand AWS Cloud offerings to the next level.
   

  

 To keep up with this demand on both disk and network capacity, we continue to expand our Data Centers in India. Also, our content delivery AWS service, CloudFront, has expanded its Data Centers presence by over 50% worldwide in the last 12 months and are expecting to increase by a similar number over the next 12 months. This requires talented people to build \& manage. We hope it is you! Come and work for the world’s most Customer Centric Company. The location for this job to be discussed, as there may be opportunities in several India locations.
   

  

 The Opportunity: Data Centre Operation Technician This role is a unique opportunity to work in some of the most advance data centers in the world. ADSIPL’s data centers are large\-scale high\-density centers where you will be working on changing the face of Cloud technology in India.
   

  

 A Data Centre Operations Tech at ADSIPL may be the primary point of contact for both internal customers (for example: Network Engineers, Systems Engineers, Software Developers, Database Engineers, Technical Operations) and external customers (Hardware Vendors, Contractors, Service Providers among others).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 There is never a dull moment as each day presents itself with different challenges. Some of the key responsibilities you will undertake are:
   

  

 Problem Solving: Maintain a high level of system reliability by prioritizing and resolving trouble tickets efficiently, these include:
   

  

* Escalation point and technical troubleshooter for all Systems and Network hardware problems
* Deep diving into Linux server issues
* XEN service virtualization troubleshooting


 Technical: Troubleshoot technical issues on various platforms ranging from Systems through Networking to Power/Mechanical
   

  

* Remediation of physical layer outages, both Systems \& Network
* Remediation or recovery of physical power issues on racks
* Participate in Data Center power \& cooling events


 Operations: Meet 24x7 On\-Call requirements and response during shift rotations.
   

  

* Install \& configure racks of hosts in line with internal SLAs
* Triage \& resolve trouble tickets for all devices in your region
* Data Center point of contact for all High Severity issues
* Physical replacement of server and network device parts
* Ensure correct rotation of parts \& spares
* Help define metrics to increase our customer uptime
* Enforcing Security Best Practices at ADSIPL
* Interact with third party vendors \& contractors
* Contribute ideas to improve operational efficiency


**Project Management**
* Participate in and deliver on a number of high impact small to mid\-scale projects
* Participate in internal team meetings at ADSIPL for metric analysis and project status updates
* Help build the world’s largest Cloud infrastructure in India


 Mentoring: Share knowledge and help educate less technical staff on the best practices related to all break fix issues
   

  

 Hiring: Contribute towards building a great team by getting involved in the ADSIPL’s hiring process/candidate interviews
   

  

**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 1\+ years of computer networking experience
* 1\+ years of Linux operating systems experience
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
* Can lift and rack equipment up to 40 pounds


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Can work in cramped spaces or in elevated locations while adhering to health \& safety guidelines
* Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure
* Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system
* Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies
* Experience working in a data center environment (racking and stacking gear, cable management, hot/cold aisle containment)


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Software Asset Management Analyst I
description:
**Role Overview**
 The Software Asset \& License Analyst I is the front line of the software service, working the high\-volume request queues to tight turnaround targets: listed software requests within 3 days, standard SaaS provisioning within 1 day, and licence\-issue resolution for users who cannot get into the software they need. The role is measured on speed and accuracy — the queue is large enough that consistency matters more than individual heroics, and errors here surface later as compliance gaps or duplicate spend.
   

  

 The associate works one of the three IST\-anchored shifts under that shift's Level III lead, with a Level II analyst mentoring day to day. Five of these roles exist — one on APAC and two each on EMEA and NAMER. The role is deliberately bounded: anything carrying legal, privacy or commercial judgment — unlisted software, signed agreements, high\-risk use cases, contract events — is escalated rather than decided, and knowing where that line sits is a core competency of the job.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Listed Software Request Fulfilment
* Execute listed\-software requests via storefront and ticket queues, consistently achieving the 3\-day turnaround SLA.
* Optimize license utilization by identifying reusable entitlements before proceeding with new fulfillment or procurement.
* Validate requester eligibility against product constraints and delivery restrictions to ensure compliant fulfillment.
* Maintain real\-time accuracy of asset and entitlement records throughout the license lifecycle.
* SaaS Provisioning \& Access Verification
* Fulfill standard SaaS requests within 24 hours, verifying active user access prior to ticket closure.
* Apply precise account tiering (e.g., Developer vs. Collaborator) to match publisher\-specific license structures.
* Audit automated provisioning outputs, proactively flagging and resolving failures to prevent service gaps.
* Manage routine deprovisioning; escalate complex scenarios involving data\-loss risks to Level II analysts.
* Licence Issue Resolution \& User Support
* Resolve technical license issues—including activation and access errors—within shift\-specific resolution targets.
* Guide users through software deployment, including the configuration of hosted floating\-license pools.
* Escalate server\-side technical issues to Level III and commercial/legal inquiries to Level II with detailed context.
* Deliver clear, professional user support to drive high customer satisfaction scores (CSAT).
* Queue Hygiene, Data Handling \& Documentation
* Uphold rigorous ticket hygiene and category coding to ensure accurate reporting and trend analysis.
* Protect sensitive data by immediately transferring tickets containing keys or audit info to private queues.
* Enforce operational boundaries by escalating unlisted software and high\-risk use cases rather than self\-actioning.
* Proactively monitor intake forms to flag ageing items for handover before the shift window closes.
* Adhere strictly to SOPs while contributing improvements to the shared knowledge base.


**PERFORMANCE \& SERVICE LEVELS**
 Indicative performance targets for the role; final service levels are confirmed on engagement and measured per shift.
   

  

* Listed Software Turnaround: fulfil listed\-software requests within the 3\-day target.
* SaaS Provisioning Turnaround: complete standard SaaS provisioning within the 1\-day target, with user access verified before closure.
* First\-Time\-Right: sustain high accuracy on catalogue item, edition, quantity and tier selection, since rework here creates duplicate spend and compliance noise.
* Escalation Discipline: 100% of bounded exclusions — unlisted software, signed agreements, high\-risk use cases — escalated rather than actioned.
* Data Handling: 100% of sensitive tickets moved to the private queue on identification.
* Ticket Hygiene: correct category coding and complete records on every ticket worked.
* Customer Satisfaction: meet the shift's customer satisfaction and time\-to\-resolve targets.


**TOOLS \& SYSTEMS**
* Queue \& Ticketing: the enterprise ticketing queue system with category coding, issue tracking, and the private queue for sensitive tickets.
* Storefront \& Provisioning: the internal software storefront and catalogue, and the provisioning and automated deprovisioning platforms.
* Entitlement Records: Flexera / ServiceNow SAM for entitlement and assignment records.
* Reference \& Knowledge: the SOP knowledge base, product catalogue and publisher playbooks.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
**Mandatory**
* 1–3\+ years in IT service desk, software provisioning, asset administration or a comparable high\-volume transactional operations role.
* Demonstrated accuracy and throughput on a ticket\-based queue against defined turnaround targets.
* Basic understanding of software licensing concepts — entitlement, assignment, seat counts and the difference between installed and SaaS delivery.
* Sound judgment about the limits of the role: able to recognise a request that must be escalated rather than fulfilled.
* Comfortable working one of three IST\-anchored shifts, including the NAMER window (22:00–06:00 IST).
* Clear, courteous English communication with end users.


**Preferred**
* Exposure to software asset management or IT asset management tooling (Flexera, ServiceNow SAM).
* Experience with an enterprise software storefront or self\-service catalogue.
* Familiarity with major publisher provisioning flows and account tiering.
* Spreadsheet proficiency for tracker and reporting support.
* Foundation\-level ITIL or software asset management certification, or working towards one.

title: Human Resources Information System Specialist
description:
A Fortune 200 company building its Global Capability Centre (GCC) in India has partnered with Flexiple to hire a Human Resources Information System Specialist to own the HR technology backbone for a centre that is scaling past two thousand employees this year.
 



**The systems you would run** 



* Administer and configure the core HRIS (employee records, org structure, workflows, approvals) across every India entity the centre supports
* Own end to end data integrity for hires, transfers, promotions and exits, including audit trails for statutory reporting
* Build and maintain integrations between the HRIS, payroll, benefits and time and attendance platforms
* Manage user access, security roles and periodic access reviews in line with the parent company's global controls



**What breaks when HRIS data is wrong** 




 Payroll runs late, statutory filings get flagged, and managers lose trust in headcount numbers used for budgeting. This role exists to make sure that never happens by catching data issues before they reach downstream systems, and by building validation checks that flag anomalies automatically rather than waiting for someone to notice a mismatched report.
 



**What we need from day one** 




 Two to five years working directly inside an HRIS platform (Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Darwinbox or similar), strong Excel and reporting skills, comfort writing SOPs for a global stakeholder base, and the judgment to know when a data anomaly is a typo versus a process gap that needs escalating. Experience supporting a multinational or GCC environment is a strong plus.
 



 Based out of Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune or Remote (India), with periodic travel to other India office locations as the centre grows.
 



**After you apply** 




 The process runs HR Screening, followed by a data and systems assignment, a hiring manager conversation, and a short culture round with the India HR leadership team.
 



 One application is kept on file and considered against this role as well as future HRIS and HR technology openings that come up across Flexiple's client roster.

title: Senior Service Desk Analyst
description:
**Are you ready to shape the future of data?** 



  


 Matillion is the company behind Maia, the AI Data Automation platform. 
 


  


 In the AI economy, demand for data is exploding. Manual data engineering can’t keep up. Maia fixes that by combining 15 years of data expertise with agentic AI to eliminate the manual work that slows data teams down. Organisations like Cisco, DocuSign, and Slack are already using it to deliver real business impact, faster.
 


  


 We started in Manchester and now we’re global \- with teams across the UK, US and India.
 


  


 We are driven, curious, energetic people who move fast, think big and hold ourselves to a high standard. We’re here to make a dent in the universe bigger than ourselves. And we’re looking for people who want to be part of it.
 


  





  




 Role Purpose
   


  


 As an IT Service Desk Analyst in our Hyderabad office, you will be the primary point of contact for our US\-based team during their business hours, while also picking up and resolving support tickets raised by our global workforce.
 **Please note: this role covers US business hours, which means working night shifts from our Hyderabad office.** 
 This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of AI\-driven support, collaborating with Felix — our AI virtual teammate — to maintain a high\-velocity, high\-quality service queue.
 


  


 Your team will leverage advanced AI tools like Claude, Gemini and n8n to automate routine workflows and triage incidents, allowing you to focus your expertise on resolving technical challenges across Windows, macOS, and our SaaS ecosystem. You will operate with significant autonomy as the sole Service Desk analyst on shift, backed by a global IT network across the UK and India, ensuring seamless handovers and collaborative problem\-solving.
 


  


 We are seeking a proactive professional who takes complete ownership of the user experience, blending human technical intuition with AI efficiency to deliver world\-class support in a fast\-paced, innovative environment.
 


  






  




**What You Will Be Doing** 
  


**Ticket Ownership \& Technical Support:** 
 Be the primary point of contact for the Service Desk during US hours, triaging and independently troubleshooting hardware, software, network, and application issues across Windows and macOS — supporting our global workforce, with a focus on the US\-based team during your shift.
 


  


**Partnering with Felix:** 
 Work alongside Felix, our AI virtual Service Desk teammate, picking up tickets it can't fully resolve and using its triage and summaries to work efficiently. Continuously look for opportunities to improve automation and self\-service.
 


  


**SLA Management \& Escalation:** 
 Own tickets end\-to\-end in the ITSM system, working to ITIL/ITSM best practice and meeting SLA targets, escalating to the wider IT team in the UK — or to third\-line specialists and external vendors — only where genuinely necessary, with full context handed over.
 


  


**Identity \& Endpoint Management:** 
 Execute secure user provisioning and device lifecycle management using Okta, Jamf, and Microsoft Intune to maintain fleet compliance and security integrity.
 


  


**SaaS Platform Administration:** 
 Administer core SaaS platforms — including Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, and the Atlassian suite (Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence) — managing users, access, configuration, and licensing.
 


  


**Onboarding \& Offboarding:** 
 Work closely with PeopleOps to onboard and offboard users as they join or leave the organisation, ensuring provisioning and de\-provisioning is completed accurately and on time.
 


  


**AI \& Automation Tooling:** 
 Use AI assistants such as Claude and Gemini, and automation platforms such as n8n, to speed up triage, draft responses, summarise incidents, and automate repetitive workflows; suggest new areas where automation could reduce manual effort.
 


  


**Cross\-Timezone Handover \& Documentation:** 
 Maintain clear, accurate handover notes for the wider IT Service Desk team covering open escalations, overnight developments, and anything requiring follow\-up; maintain and improve knowledge base articles and documentation.
 


  


**Change \& Project Support:** 
 Take ownership of smaller changes and contribute to larger IT projects — system upgrades, deployments, and migrations — including testing, documentation, and rollout.
 


  


  




**What We Are Looking For** 
  

 Technical / Role Specific — Essential
   


 2–4 years' experience in a 2nd line or standalone IT support role, with a track record of resolving complex issues independently rather than simply triaging them.
 


  


 Strong working knowledge of both Windows and macOS environments.
 


  


 Hands\-on experience administering an identity provider (e.g. Okta or similar) and an MDM platform (e.g. Jamf, Intune).
 


  


 Comfortable working within ITIL/ITSM frameworks and using a ticketing system such as Jira Service Management, with a genuine understanding of SLAs and the ability to work effectively within them.
 


  


 Practical experience with core SaaS platforms: Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, and the Atlassian suite.
 


  


 Comfortable using AI assistants (e.g. Claude, Gemini) as part of daily troubleshooting, documentation, and communication, and genuinely enthusiastic about working alongside an AI virtual teammate (Felix) rather than seeing it as a threat.
 


  


 A self\-starter who can review and improve business processes, take ownership of IT initiatives, and prioritise workload based on urgency and impact.
 


  


  




**Desirable** 
  


 Experience with Confluence for documentation and knowledge base management.
 


  


 Exposure to workflow automation tooling such as n8n, or a strong enthusiasm to learn it, to build or improve automations.
 


  


 Experience with endpoint security / EDR tooling (e.g. CrowdStrike).
 


  


 Experience working in a SaaS\-first, multi\-office, or globally distributed organisation, including handing over work across time zones.
 


  


 Experience with software licence audits and vendor management.
 


  


 Familiarity with formal change management processes and change tickets.
 


  


  




**Personal Capabilities Required** 
  


 This role covers US business hours (night shift) and is based in our Hyderabad office.
 


  


 Comfortable working with a high degree of autonomy as the only Service Desk analyst on shift, with the judgement to know when to handle something yourself and when to escalate to the wider IT team in the UK, rather than relying on a local backup.
 


  


 Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate technical detail for non\-technical stakeholders and write clear handover notes for colleagues in other time zones.
 


  


 A genuine sense of ownership — proactively drives tickets and projects to resolution rather than waiting to be told what to do.
 


  


 Ability to manage your own workload, prioritise effectively and stay organised under pressure.
 


  


 The business invests significantly in personal development; a strong desire to use these opportunities and turn new skills into continual service improvement is important to success.

title: Engineer I - Cloud Support Engineer
description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
