 Want to learn AWS by running it at a Tier 1 financial firm? As Engineer 1, Cloud Support Engineer, you'll be first on the ticket — triaging requests, running runbooks, and shadowing incidents — with senior engineers, AVPs, and the VP, Support right beside you and a clear certification path to Engineer 2\. If you're hungry to grow into a serious cloud engineer with a globally distributed team across the US and India, this is your seat.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 As the Engineer 1, Cloud Support Engineer, you are a hands\-on entry\-level cloud operations engineer in the Support team within LPL's Cloud Center of Excellence (CCOE) — the run\-the\-cloud function for LPL's AWS multi\-account landing zone. Under close guidance from senior engineers, AVPs, and the VP, Support, you triage inbound tickets from application teams across Jira and ServiceNow, execute runbooks, fulfill well\-scoped account / IAM / access requests, and act as a supported first\-line responder in the 24x7 on\-call rotation. You partner with the Monitoring pod within Foundations on alerting and runbooks, and you escalate cleanly to Engineer 2s and above when work is beyond your current scope. LPL is an AWS\-first CCOE: a multi\-account landing zone with 100\+ private reusable Terraform modules that enable 60\+ AWS services, delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions. You spend the majority of your time hands\-on and learning — progressing along the Engineer 1 certification path (AWS Cloud Practitioner, Terraform Associate, KCNA) toward Engineer 2 — across LPL's US offices and India Global Capability Center (GCC).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Triage inbound tickets from application teams across Jira and ServiceNow against clear SLAs under guidance: own well\-scoped Tier 1 requests end\-to\-end and escalate cleanly to Engineer 2s, AVPs, and the VP, Support when work is beyond your current scope
* Fulfill well\-scoped account / IAM / access requests using the Account Factory for Terraform (AFT) and the private Terraform module library, following established runbooks
* Execute runbooks for known incident classes and help keep them accurate; partner with the Monitoring pod within Foundations to capture what you learn
* Support change\-management execution: change\-window participation and ServiceNow change\-record discipline under senior review
* Embed agentic AI capabilities into the team's engineering practice (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Bedrock, MCP servers, agentic IaC and review workflows) and into the platform's self\-service experience for internal customers
* Use agentic AI capabilities in your day\-to\-day support work: AI\-assisted ticket triage, runbook lookup and generation, MCP\-driven self\-service for common account / IAM / access requests, and on\-call copilots that summarize telemetry during incidents
* Operate as a hands\-on entry\-level cloud engineer under close guidance: spend the majority of your time on well\-scoped Terraform changes, AWS console / CLI tasks, ticket and runbook execution, and shadowing incident response — building core cloud skills is the primary focus
* Participate in 24x7 on\-call rotations as a supported first\-line responder, following runbooks and escalating early to Engineer 2s, AVPs, and VPs
* Consume the private Terraform module library and reference patterns to ship small, well\-scoped changes; raise focused pull requests that a senior engineer reviews before merge
* Partner with peer engineers, AVPs, and VPs across the Cloud Center of Excellence — the five CCOE teams (Foundations, Platforms, Containers, Support, Delivery) and the five Foundations pods (Security \& Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering \& Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring) — to deliver pod outcomes; ask for help early and write down what you learn
* Apply the AWS Well\-Architected Framework to the work you touch under senior guidance
* Participate fully in Agile / Scrum ceremonies (sprint planning, standups, backlog grooming, retrospectives) with the pod's embedded Scrum Master
* Pursue and maintain the Engineer 1 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix — AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004\), and Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA) — progressing toward Engineer 2 over time


 What are we looking for?
   

  

 We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast\-paced, team\-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.
   

  

**Requirements**
* 1\+ years of technical experience in cloud, infrastructure, or software engineering (internship / co\-op / bootcamp experience counts); Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent work experience)
* Foundational AWS exposure and a demonstrated willingness to learn Terraform in a private module ecosystem delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions
* Demonstrated ability to complete well\-scoped technical tasks under guidance, with reliable follow\-through and a strong learning mindset
* Willingness to participate in 24x7 production on\-call rotations as a supported first\-line responder in a fast\-paced, security\-conscious environment (financial services preferred)
* Familiarity with an ITSM / ticketing workflow (Jira, ServiceNow, or comparable) and a strong customer\-service orientation toward application teams


**Core Competencies**
* Strong growth mindset — actively pursues the Engineer 1 certifications in the CCOE certification matrix and treats every ticket and incident as a learning loop
* Highly coachable; acts on feedback and improves quickly
* Asks for help early rather than struggling alone, and documents what they learn for the next engineer
* Reliable, careful execution on well\-scoped work
* Continuous learner in cloud\-native, IaC, and applied AI
* Builds trusting relationships with peer engineers across the US and India / GCC
* Clear written and verbal communication in tickets and pull requests


**Preferences**
* On the Engineer 1 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
* On the Engineer 1 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004\)
* On the Engineer 1 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA)
* Exposure to agentic AI / GenAI tooling (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Bedrock, MCP) in day\-to\-day work
* Scripting exposure in Python, Bash, or PowerShell
* Experience working with globally distributed teams across the US and India / GCC

title: Sr. Service Engineer
description:
Service Engineer 2 — Hardware Asset Management
   

  

 Endpoint Onboarding, Testing \& Asset Lifecycle \| Endpoint Engineering Services \| Hyderabad \| 2–4 years
   

  

 ROLE PURPOSE
   

  

 Execute the hands\-on work that gets new endpoint hardware certified and keeps the asset record honest. You will test candidate laptops, desktops, thin clients and peripherals against a defined certification suite, package and validate driver and firmware updates, and maintain accurate lifecycle records — working under the direction of a Senior Service Engineer who owns the standard.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Run certification testing. Execute the test checklist on new laptop, desktop, thin client, zero client and peripheral models. Capture results, defects and evidence in a consistent, reviewable format.
* Validate build and deployment readiness. Confirm Autopilot and MECM enrolment, driver packs, imaging and OS readiness on candidate hardware — Windows 11, IGEL OS, Dell ThinOS, HP ThinPro.
* Keep firmware, BIOS and drivers current. Package and test driver and BIOS updates, apply the approved BIOS/UEFI baseline, verify remote update paths, and track OEM advisories for the models you own.
* Test peripherals and clinical accessories. Docks, monitors, headsets, tap/badge readers, barcode scanners, label printers, carts and workstation\-on\-wheels configurations.
* Maintain asset accuracy. Keep HAM and CMDB records clean — serial and asset\-tag reconciliation, warranty and entitlement data, stockroom movements — and pull the evidence needed for audits.
* Support secure disposition. Prepare retiring devices for sanitisation and disposal with the approved method and complete chain\-of\-custody documentation.
* Document and support. Write SOPs, test reports and known\-issue notes; support L2/L3 escalations for hardware faults; raise and follow through OEM warranty and RMA cases.


**Skills And Experience We Need**
* 2–4 years in endpoint support or engineering in a mid\-to\-large enterprise.
* Windows 11 endpoints, hands\-on. Working knowledge of Microsoft Intune and Autopilot, or MECM/ConfigMgr.
* Hardware fundamentals. BIOS/UEFI settings, TPM, secure boot, drivers, firmware, docking and display behaviour — and the confidence to open a device and diagnose it.
* Some exposure to thin clients and virtual desktops. At least one thin client platform (IGEL, ThinOS, ThinPro) and one VDI or DaaS environment (Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365, Citrix, Omnissa Horizon).
* OEM support processes. Dell TechDirect, HP or Lenovo support portals; warranty validation and RMA handling.
* Structured testing habits. You follow a test plan, record what actually happened, and write it up so someone else can act on it.
* ITSM and data discipline. ServiceNow ticket hygiene, plus solid spreadsheet skills for inventory and reconciliation work.


**Preferred**
* MD\-102, CompTIA A\+, or an OEM hardware certification (Dell / HP / Lenovo / IGEL); ITIL 4 Foundation.
* Exposure to asset tooling (ServiceNow HAM, Lansweeper, Flexera) or DEX tooling (Nexthink, ControlUp).
* Basic PowerShell for reporting and repetitive validation tasks.
* Experience in healthcare or another regulated environment with shared and clinical devices.


**How Success Is Measured**
* Test\-cycle turnaround time and completeness of test evidence.
* Defects that escape testing and surface after deployment.
* Accuracy of asset records against physical and discovered inventory.
* Quality and reuse of the SOPs and test reports you produce.
* Ticket and RMA closure within SLA.

 When a production cloud incident hits a Tier 1 financial firm at 2 a.m., someone senior has to own it. As AVP, Cloud Support Engineer, you're that person — the senior escalation point for LPL's run\-the\-cloud function, taking the hardest tickets and incidents end\-to\-end and turning recurring toil into automated, self\-service paths. If you want to operate AWS at scale with a globally distributed team across the US and India, this is your seat.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 As the AVP, Cloud Support Engineer, you are a hands\-on senior cloud operations engineer in the Support team in LPL's Cloud Center of Excellence (CCOE) — the run\-the\-cloud function for LPL's AWS multi\-account landing zone. You are the senior escalation point for the Support team's 24x7 Tier 1 / Tier 2 queue: you take the hardest tickets and production incidents end\-to\-end, own operational excellence, and decide when to pull in the Foundations pods (Security \& Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering \& Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring), Platforms, Containers, or Delivery. You partner closely with the Monitoring pod within Foundations on alerting and runbooks. LPL is an AWS\-first CCOE: a multi\-account landing zone with 100\+ private reusable Terraform modules that enable 60\+ AWS services, delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions. You spend the majority of your time hands\-on in troubleshooting, runbooks, Terraform, and incident response — and you continuously turn repeatable requests into automated, self\-service paths — across LPL's US offices and India Global Capability Center (GCC).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Operate as a hands\-on senior cloud support engineer: spend the majority of your time in production troubleshooting, runbook authoring and execution, Terraform changes, complex ticket resolution, and incident response — hands\-on operations is the primary leverage point
* Serve as the senior escalation point for the Support team's Tier 1 / Tier 2 queue: take the hardest tickets and production incidents end\-to\-end, and decide when to pull in the Foundations pods (Security \& Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering \& Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring), Platforms, Containers, or Delivery. Turn recurring toil into durable fixes: convert repeatable account / IAM / access requests and incident classes into self\-service paths through the Account Factory for Terraform (AFT) and the private Terraform module library
* Own operational excellence for the run\-the\-cloud function: runbook quality, change\-management discipline in ServiceNow, post\-incident reviews, and SLA / operational metrics; partner with the Monitoring pod within Foundations to close monitoring and alerting gaps. Embed agentic AI capabilities into the team's engineering practice (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Bedrock, MCP servers, agentic IaC and review workflows) and into the platform's self\-service experience for internal customers
* Use agentic AI capabilities to raise the run\-the\-cloud bar: AI\-assisted triage and root\-cause analysis, MCP\-driven conversational self\-service for common requests, automated runbook generation, and on\-call copilots that summarize telemetry and chat during incidents
* Personally participate in 24x7 on\-call rotations as a senior technical responder and escalation point for production incidents. Partner with peer engineers, AVPs, and VPs across the Cloud Center of Excellence — the five CCOE teams (Foundations, Platforms, Containers, Support, Delivery) and the five Foundations pods (Security \& Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering \& Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring) — to align roadmaps and remove cross\-team and cross\-pod blockers
* Raise engineering quality across the pod through code review, design partnership, and technical pairing — acting as a force multiplier without direct reports. Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies (sprint planning, standups, backlog grooming, retrospectives) and partner with the RTE and PMO on delivery commitments and dependencies


 What are we looking for?
   

  

 We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast\-paced, team\-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.
   

  

**Requirements**
* 12\+ years of progressive technical experience including 5\+ years in a senior cloud security, network security, or cloud infrastructure engineering role; Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent work experience)
* 5\+ years of hands\-on production AWS at scale in a multi\-account landing zone with strong production Terraform delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions

title: Senior Engineer, Identity and Access Management
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Purpose**
 Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. (ICE) is a leading operator of global exchanges, clearing houses, data, and listings services. We connect businesses around the world to unique opportunities in markets that drive the global economy. We are a diverse and inclusive company that values innovation, collaboration, and excellence. ICE team members work across departments and traditional boundaries to innovate and respond to industry demand. A successful candidate will be able to multitask in a dynamic team\-based environment demonstrating strong problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities and the highest degree of professionalism.
   

  

 As an Identity and Access Management (IAM) professional, you will be responsible for ensuring the security and integrity of our IT systems and applications. You will design, implement, and maintain policies and systems that control user identities, credentials, roles, and permissions across various IT platforms and applications. You will also monitor and audit user activities, troubleshoot issues, and comply with IT standards and regulations. To succeed in this role, you will need strong technical skills, analytical thinking, problem\-solving abilities, and knowledge of IT security best practices.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Application \& Infrastructure Maintenance
+ Administer, maintain, and support ForgeRock/Ping OpenIDM and OpenDS directory services in production and non\-production environments
+ Monitor system health, performance, and availability; perform proactive tuning and capacity planning
+ Manage directory replication, schema extensions, indexing, and access control policies
+ Perform upgrades, patching, and configuration changes in accordance with change management processes
+ Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to directory services, authentication, and identity workflows
+ Maintain high availability and disaster recovery configurations for IAM infrastructure

* Linux Administration
+ Manage and maintain Linux\-based servers hosting IAM applications and directory services
+ Perform OS\-level troubleshooting, log analysis, and performance diagnostics
+ Implement and maintain system hardening standards and security configurations
+ Coordinate with infrastructure teams on server provisioning, networking, and storage

* Scripting \& Automation
+ Develop and maintain scripts to automate routine operational tasks, monitoring, and reporting (Bash, Python, or similar)
+ Automate provisioning, de\-provisioning, and reconciliation workflows
+ Build tooling to support bulk directory operations, data migrations, and schema management
+ Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines related to IAM configuration and deployments

* AI Adoption \& Enablement
+ Stay current with emerging AI tools and capabilities relevant to IAM operations, security, and automation
+ Identify and champion opportunities to incorporate AI\-assisted tooling into day\-to\-day workflows, such as anomaly detection, access pattern analysis, and automated remediation
+ Use AI coding and scripting assistants responsibly to accelerate development of automation and operational tooling
+ Contribute to team best practices and guardrails around responsible AI usage in an identity and security context

* Other
+ Partner with security, application, and infrastructure teams to integrate identity services with enterprise applications
+ Produce and maintain technical documentation including runbooks, architecture diagrams, and standard operating procedures
+ Participate in on\-call rotation and provide escalation support for P1/P2 incidents
+ Mentor junior team members and contribute to team knowledge sharing
+ Works independently on many IT projects as a project team member, more frequently as a project leader.
+ Often provides strategic direction, guidance, and integration of services.
+ Communicate verbally and in writing to technical and non\-technical audiences of various levels both internally and externally
+ Develop partnership\-oriented relationships with business executives and functional leaders, especially as it relates to operations and technology
+ Multitask in a fast\-paced environment with a focus on timeliness, documentation, and communications with peers and business users
+ Involved in the evaluation of products and/or procedures to enhance productivity and effectiveness


**Knowledge And Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or an equivalent combination of education, training, or work experience
* 5\+ years of experience in Identity \& Access Management or directory services engineering
* Hands\-on experience with ForgeRock OpenIDM and/or OpenDS (or Ping Identity directory products)
* Strong Linux administration skills (RHEL preferred)
* Proficiency in scripting languages such as Bash and/or Python for automation and operational tooling
* Solid understanding of LDAP concepts: schema, replication, ACIs, indexing, and directory architecture
* Experience supporting enterprise IAM in a production environment
* Experience designing, implementing, or supporting multi\-factor authentication (MFA) solutions, including hardware tokens, YubiKeys, authenticator applications, push notifications, and/or certificate\-based authentication.
* Familiarity with authentication protocols: LDAP, Kerberos, SAML, OAuth2/OIDC
* Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills
* Requires extensive knowledge of relevant IT system issues, techniques, and implications across all existing server platforms.
* Must have extensive knowledge in networking, databases, systems, and/or Web operations.


**Preferred Knowledge And Experience**
* Knowledge of ICE business environment and the ability to evaluate implications of changes to IT systems
* Experience with additional ForgeRock/Ping Identity products (AM, PingFederate, PingDirectory)
* Familiarity with HashiCorp Vault or other secrets management solutions
* Experience with containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) in the context of IAM workloads
* Knowledge of SCIM provisioning standards
* Exposure to cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and hybrid identity architectures
* ForgeRock Certified Identity Professional or equivalent certification
* Knowledge of relevant legal and regulatory requirements
* Knowledge of common Identity Access Management frameworks
* Experience working with a diverse range of data sources/streams and managing these effectively
* Excellent analytical, decision\-making, and problem\-solving skills
* Knowledge of multiple operating systems and related utilities and hardware
* Knowledge of storage management, TCP/IP, and network monitoring and tools
* Strong background in operations, processes, solutions, and technologies
* Strong understanding of policy, compliance, and best practice Identity Access Management principles
* Working knowledge of Linux, Windows, and Network Operating Systems
* Knowledge of infrastructure, key processes, and technology\-oriented risk issues, specifically around Identity Access Management and privacy
* Results oriented, business focused, and successful at interfacing across multiple organizational units
* Professional certification such as CISSP, CISM, etc.

This role is the highest level of application support, responsible for resolving complex, high\-priority production issues across our benefits administration platform. The ideal candidate will be a technical expert with deep knowledge of enterprise applications, strong analytical abilities, and experience in healthcare benefits systems.
 



 You will serve as a critical escalation point for unresolved incidents, leading root cause analysis, troubleshooting complex integrations, and driving resolution through collaboration with Engineering, Product, QA, and Customer Success teams. Your work ensures system stability, data integrity, and exceptional customer experience in a fast\-paced, mission\-critical environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Serve as the primary escalation point for complex, high\-impact production issues reported by customers or internal teams.
* Conduct in\-depth root cause analysis (RCA) using application logs, database records, API traces, and system workflows.
* Reproduce and validate reported issues in staging or test environments to isolate technical and business\-process defects.
* Perform advanced troubleshooting across multi\-tiered systems, including backend services, databases, APIs, and integrations (e.g., HRIS, payroll, third\-party benefit providers).
* Write and execute complex SQL queries to analyze data anomalies, validate business logic, and support diagnostics.
* Collaborate closely with Engineering teams to triage, document, and prioritize fixes; provide detailed technical feedback and reproducible test cases.
* Partner with Product and QA to clarify requirements, validate bug fixes, and support regression testing.
* Work with Customer Success to communicate technical status, timelines, and resolution strategies to stakeholders.
* Document findings, solutions, and knowledge base articles to improve team efficiency and reduce future escalations.
* Monitor system health and proactively identify potential issues through log analysis and performance trends.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 3\+ years of experience in technical support, application support, or software engineering roles, with proven experience at Tier 3 or equivalent level.
* Deep understanding of benefits administration systems (e.g., health, dental, vision, retirement, FSA/HSA) and associated workflows.
* Strong hands\-on experience with SQL (query optimization, joins, subqueries, stored procedures) and database troubleshooting.
* Proficiency in analyzing logs (application, server, API), understanding system behavior, and identifying patterns in error messages.
* Working knowledge of RESTful APIs, web services, and integration platforms (e.g., MuleSoft, Informatica, Zapier, etc.).
* Familiarity with scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash for automation and log parsing.
* Experience with agile development methodologies and ticketing systems (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow).
* Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills.

 As a Customer Support Engineer, you are the first human our users reach when something isn’t working, and the person who makes sure they leave the conversation reassured, understood and back on track. Helfie is a regulated health product, so the quality, accuracy, and care you bring to every interaction matters enormously. **Key responsibilities:** 



* Own the first\-line response to customer queries and issues across all support channels, providing timely, empathetic, and clear communication.
* Troubleshoot and resolve product issues directly where possible, guiding users through the app, its AI health checks (heart rate, blood pressure, cough, skin, and more), account and login flows, and common how\-to questions.
* Triage incoming issues: distinguish user error, configuration, and genuine product defects, gathering the right detail (steps to reproduce, device, screenshots, logs) before escalating.
* Escalate technical and platform issues to the engineering teams with clear, well\-documented tickets, and track them through to resolution on the customer’s behalf.
* Act as the voice of the customer internally \- surfacing recurring pain points and themes to product and engineering to drive improvements.
* Manage and prioritise the support queue in Jira, keeping tickets accurate, up to date, and within response and resolution targets.
* Maintain and grow the support knowledge base and help content in Confluence (FAQs, troubleshooting guides and canned responses).
* Keep accurate records of customer interactions and issue handling, consistent with the expectations of a regulated health product.
* Collaborate closely with clinical / regulatory, QA, and engineering to ensure customer facing answers about health features are accurate and appropriate.
* Leverage AI agents and tools to draft and refine responses, summarise and cluster tickets, surface relevant knowledge base content, and automate routine support tasks.



  





**Skills \& experience:** 




**Must\-Have Background** 



* 3\+ years in a customer support, technical support, or customer success role, ideally for a software, SaaS or app\-based product.
* Experience with support and ticketing tools (Jira, Zoho, Zendesk, or similar) and a track record of writing clear, reusable help documentation.
* Comfortable navigating mobile and web apps and basic technical concepts such as logins and authentication, app settings, and common error patterns.



  





**Troubleshooting \& Technical Aptitude** 



* A strong troubleshooting mindset \- methodical, curious, and good at narrowing down a problem and reliably reproducing it.
* Able to capture the right diagnostic detail and write defect tickets that engineers can act on without back\-and\-forth.
* Comfortable using AI tools (LLMs, AI\-assisted help\-desk and knowledge tools, and AI\-powered workflows).



  





**Communication \& Mindset** 



* Excellent written and verbal communication \- able to explain things simply and patiently to non\-technical users.
* A customer\-first attitude with patience, empathy and a genuine sense of ownership over getting issues resolved.
* Sound judgment around sensitive health information and the discretion a regulated product demands.



  





**Benefits:** 



* Opportunities for professional growth and creative development.
* Flexible working hours with remote work options.
* A vibrant, collaborative team environment.



  





**Equal opportunity statement** 




 Helfie.ai is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We will not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, sex, race, religion or belief, gender reassignment, marriage / civil partnership, pregnancy or sexual orientation. We encourage applications from a wide range of candidates and selection for roles will be based on individual merit alone.

 Reports to \- Senior Manager, Implementations, Brightedge
 



  





 BrightEdge is seeking an experienced
 **Site Agent Implementation Specialist (Senior)** 
 to lead the implementation, optimization, and long\-term success of Site Agent, one of BrightEdge's most strategic automation products. This role combines deep technical implementation expertise with customer relationship management and program ownership to deliver exceptional customer outcomes across Enterprise and Mid\-Market accounts.
 



  





 As the primary technical owner for a portfolio of Site Agent customers, you will manage implementations from technical discovery through go\-live and ongoing performance optimization. You'll serve as a trusted advisor to customers while partnering closely with Customer Success, Sales, Product, Engineering, and Professional Services to maximize adoption, retention, and business value.
 



  





 In addition to managing your own portfolio, you will help scale Site Agent across BrightEdge's customer base by leading new deployments, supporting strategic renewals, mentoring teammates, and contributing to product innovation.
 



  





**Mandatory Requirement:** 
 This role requires regular customer\-facing coverage during
 **U.S. Eastern Standard Time (EST) and Pacific Standard Time (PST) business hours** 
 . Candidates must be able to consistently support customers across these time zones as part of their regular working schedule.
 



  





  





**What You'll Do** 




  





**Customer Portfolio Ownership** 



* Own and manage a portfolio of Site Agent customer accounts across both New Logo and Existing Customer business.
* Take accountability for customer health, adoption, satisfaction, and retention.
* Conduct regular customer touchpoints and quarterly business/performance reviews.
* Identify optimization opportunities and recommend SEO best practices to improve customer outcomes.
* Partner with Customer Success Managers and Strategic Account Managers on renewal and expansion strategies.



  





**Implementation \& Technical Delivery** 



* Lead end\-to\-end Site Agent implementations from kickoff through production deployment.
* Drive implementation workstreams involving:
* Client\-side JavaScript integrations
* Server\-side SDK implementations
* Sidecar and custom deployment models
* Coordinate technical discovery sessions with customers.
* Manage implementation timelines, milestones, risks, and stakeholder communication.
* Ensure successful production launches and post\-launch validation.



  





**Platform Configuration \& Optimization** 




 Configure and maintain Site Agent including:
 


* Profiles
* Source and target rules
* Priority ordering
* Anchor text logic
* Regex configuration
* Language settings
* Crawl configuration
* Page and link caps
* Additional domains



 Maintain high configuration accuracy, recognizing that every change is reflected on customer\-facing websites.
 



  





**Technical Troubleshooting** 



* Diagnose implementation and production issues using:
* Crawl data
* Site Agent Admin Panel
* Debug tools
* Regex validator
* Resolve implementation issues independently whenever possible.
* Escalate complex engineering issues with detailed technical documentation.
* Coordinate resolution of "AP Down" customer accounts and restore production health.



  





**Customer Success \& Strategic Consulting** 



* Conduct Quarterly Site Agent Performance Reviews.
* Review implementation health and KPIs.
* Deliver SEO recommendations based on customer performance.
* Reinforce the value of Site Agent automation, especially during periods of flat or declining performance.
* Support executive customer presentations including QBRs and EBRs.



  





**Cross\-Functional Partnership** 




 Collaborate closely with:
 


* Customer Success Managers
* Strategic Account Managers
* Sales
* Professional Services
* Product Management
* Engineering



 Support:
 


* Strategic renewals
* Competitive positioning
* Product adoption
* Technical discovery
* Executive customer presentations



**Product Growth \& Innovation** 



* Support rollout of new Site Agent capabilities including AP Schema and Site Agent for Mobile.
* Deploy Site Agent across new Enterprise and Mid\-Market customers.
* Participate in product feedback sessions with Engineering.
* Contribute to implementation playbooks and best practices.
* Share customer insights to influence future product direction.



**Team Leadership** 



* Mentor junior Implementation Specialists.
* Provide technical guidance during complex customer engagements.
* Share troubleshooting knowledge and implementation best practices.
* Support onboarding and cross\-training initiatives.



  





  





**Required Qualifications** 



* 5\+ years of experience in Technical Customer Success, Professional Services, Technical Implementation, Solutions Consulting, or SEO technology.
* Experience managing Enterprise customer relationships.
* Strong project and program management experience.
* Excellent executive communication and presentation skills.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent customer implementations.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities.

* JavaScript integrations

 **ThoughtSpot Cloud, Tableau Cloud/Server, and IBM Cognos Analytics on Cloud** 
 .  This is a critical role in enabling Mattel's enterprise reporting strategy while supporting the organization's ongoing analytics modernization initiatives.

* Ensure high platform availability, reliability, scalability, and performance.

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that reduce operational effort while improving service quality.

* Support implementation of secure, performant connections between reporting platforms and enterprise data sources.

**Platform Migration \& Modernization**

* Assist with migration planning, platform assessments, validation, testing, and production cutover activities.

* Identify opportunities to improve migration processes, automation, and governance.

* Develop and optimize SQL queries for reporting solutions.
* Support testing, deployment, and production validation of reporting enhancements.

**Collaboration \& Customer Support**

* Partner with business users to resolve platform\-related problems and improve user experience.
* Provide technical guidance to BI Developers regarding platform capabilities and best practices.
* Deliver administrator and end\-user training sessions.
* Create and maintain platform documentation, knowledge articles, and operational runbooks.


**Continuous Improvement**
* Evaluate emerging BI technologies and recommend platform improvements.
* Promote best practices for platform administration, governance, security, and operational excellence.
* Lead initiatives that improve platform stability, user satisfaction, and administrative efficiency.
* Foster a culture of automation, innovation, and continuous improvement across Enterprise Data \& Analytics.

title: SharePoint Support Specialist [T500-29192]
description:
**About Stolt\-Nielsen:** 




 Stolt\-Nielsen is a family\-founded global leader in bulk\-liquid and chemical logistics, transportation, and storage, known for its commitment to safety, service excellence, and innovation. At the Stolt\-Nielsen Digital Innovation Centre, we bring this legacy into the future — building smarter systems, driving digital transformation, and shaping what's next for the world of logistics. Here, you’re encouraged to think boldly, challenge convention, and help move today’s products toward tomorrow’s possibilities.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 As a SharePoint Support Specialist at Stolt\-Nielsen, you will be the first point of contact for SharePoint Online issues across the organisation, providing responsive P1 and P2 support and ensuring the platform runs smoothly day to day. You will manage site provisioning, permissions, lifecycle management, and the integration touchpoints between SharePoint and other Microsoft 365 applications.
 



 This role combines operational support with hands\-on administration, and requires strong problem\-solving ability and clear communication, since you will frequently be the one translating technical permission structures into plain language for end users and stakeholders. You will handle site creation and decommissioning, manage permissions and access reviews across multiple levels of the SharePoint and OneDrive environment, execute lifecycle management tasks (inactive site detection, owner attestation follow\-ups, archival), and support minor customization requests.
 



 You will work within a small, focused SharePoint team alongside a Team Lead and Senior Developer, with real opportunity to improve your technical skills over time.
 



  





**What You'll Do:** 



* Provide P1 and P2 support for all SharePoint Online issues across the organisation, acting as the first point of contact for end users.
* Manage day\-to\-day site provisioning, configuration, and decommissioning in line with governance policies.
* Administer permissions across all levels of the environment, including:
* Site\-level and sub\-site permissions
* Ownership assignment and transfer
* Guest\-level (external user) permissions and access reviews
* Folder\- and item\-level (unique) permissions
* OneDrive\-level sharing and access permissions
* Security group membership and Microsoft 365 group permissions
* Diagnose and resolve permission\-related issues logically and systematically, tracing access problems back to their root cause (e.g. broken inheritance, conflicting group membership, expired guest access) rather than applying quick fixes.
* Execute lifecycle management tasks including inactive site detection, owner attestation follow\-ups, and archival processes.
* Support integration touchpoints between SharePoint and other Microsoft 365 applications such as Teams, OneDrive, Outlook, and Viva Engage.
* Log, track, and report on support tickets; maintain SLA compliance and provide regular reporting on ticket volumes and resolution times.
* Communicate clearly and proactively with end users and stakeholders — explaining permission issues, timelines, and resolutions in an accessible, non\-technical way.
* Handle minor customisation requests such as page layouts, list configurations, and basic workflow adjustments.
* Assist with permission audits and access reviews in support of governance and compliance requirements.
* Maintain clear, well\-structured documentation for support procedures, known issues, permission models, and environment configurations.
* Perform additional duties and projects as assigned.



  





**What You'll Bring:** 



* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in IT, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in SharePoint Online administration within a Microsoft 365 enterprise environment.
* Strong, demonstrable understanding of SharePoint's permission model, including site, sub\-site, folder/item\-level, guest, and OneDrive permissions, and how inheritance and breaking inheritance affects access.
* Solid understanding of security groups and access management.
* Experience with site provisioning, lifecycle management, and governance processes.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365 ecosystem integration (Teams, OneDrive, Outlook, Viva Engage).
* Basic PowerShell scripting skills for administrative tasks and bulk operations.
* Strong problem\-solving and logical thinking skills, with the ability to methodically diagnose and resolve complex access and permission issues.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong service orientation with excellent communication and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple support requests, prioritise effectively, and work under SLA pressure.
* Attention to detail and commitment to thorough documentation.



  





**Must\-Have Skills:** 



* SharePoint Online administration and site management
* In\-depth knowledge of SharePoint permissions: site, sub\-site, folder/item\-level, guest access, and ownership management
* OneDrive permissions and sharing management
* Microsoft 365 permissions management and security groups
* Site provisioning, lifecycle management, and governance
* Incident management and SLA\-driven support
* Basic PowerShell scripting
* Strong problem\-solving and logical/analytical thinking
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills



  





**Nice\-to\-Have Skills:** 



* Experience with Power Automate for basic workflow automation
* Familiarity with SharePoint migration processes
* Knowledge of Microsoft Purview or other compliance and governance tools
* Experience with ticketing systems (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or similar)
* Exposure to Power Apps or SharePoint Framework (SPFx) development

 This is deliberately an operations\-first role. Around 80% of your week will be spent keeping our environments running well – monitoring, incident response, deployments, upgrades, access management and performance tuning. The remaining 20% is hands\-on development: the automation, tooling and platform components that make the operational work faster and less manual, plus occasional support to delivery teams on technical problems.
 



 If you enjoy owning a platform end to end and would rather automate a problem than repeat a workaround, this role is built for you.
 



 We take digital seriously. We invest in our teams through training and mentoring, and we give them the tools to work in a modern way. As we build up our engineering practice further, there is ample room for you to contribute, take initiative and shape our ways of working and technology landscape.
 



  





**What you'll do:** 




**Platform support and operations (80%)** 




**Environment administration:** 



* Administer and maintain our OutSystems environments across Development, Test, Acceptance and Production.
* Manage configuration, environment setup and system resources across cloud and on\-premises installations.
* Manage user roles, permissions and access controls in line with our security policies.



  





**Application lifecycle management:** 



* Run deployments, tagging, versioning and rollbacks through OutSystems Lifetime.
* Guard our ALM standards and manage dependencies so that releases stay predictable.
* Support new teams onboarding onto the platform so they can deliver reliably from the start.



  





**Monitoring and performance:** 



* Establish and maintain monitoring and alerting for availability, performance and errors.
* Monitor and optimise platform performance, database usage and environment capacity.
* Identify capacity constraints before they become incidents, and plan accordingly.



  





**Incident and problem management:** 



* Act as the escalation point for platform\-related issues, coordinating with OutSystems Support where needed.
* Lead root cause analysis and drive preventive maintenance so the same incident does not recur.
* Maintain runbooks and operational documentation to a standard others can actually follow.



  





**Upgrades and maintenance:** 



* Plan, perform and document platform upgrades, patches and scheduled maintenance, working with our development and infrastructure teams.
* Oversee database management on SQL Server, including backups, schema evolution and performance tuning.



  





**Development and automation (20%):** 



* Build automation that removes manual operational steps, deployment scripts, health checks, environment provisioning, routine reporting.
* Integrate OutSystems into our CI/CD pipelines alongside the DevOps team.
* Develop and maintain reusable platform components, integrations and shared services used across applications.
* Provide hands\-on technical support to OutSystems developers on integration, performance and architecture questions.
* Contribute to architecture discussions and help define our operational standards for low\-code environments.



  





**What you'll bring:** 



* Proven experience managing OutSystems platforms in an enterprise, multi\-environment setup.
* Strong understanding of OutSystems architecture across front\-end, service and integration layers.
* Working knowledge of OutSystems Lifetime, Service Center, Integration Studio and the Infrastructure Management Console.
* Practical database administration experience\-Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle or similar.
* Working knowledge of Azure infrastructure, PaaS components and network and security fundamentals.
* Familiarity with DevOps principles, CI/CD tooling and automation scripting in PowerShell, Python or Bash.
* Excellent documentation skills and a genuine eye for operational detail.
* The ability to work with developers, infrastructure teams and security specialists to keep the platform healthy and aligned with our wider goals.



  





**Must\-have skills:** 



* 5\+ years in IT operations, platform administration or DevOps roles.
* 3\+ years of OutSystems platform administration experience.
* Strong knowledge of OutSystems Lifetime and environment management.
* Database management on SQL Server or Oracle.
* Platform monitoring, maintenance and troubleshooting.
* Understanding of OutSystems ALM, deployment flows and dependency management.
* Familiarity with networking, firewalls and identity management using Azure AD or Entra ID.



  





**Nice to have:** 



* Scripting for operational automation at scale, rather than one\-off fixes.
* Experience introducing monitoring or observability tooling to a platform that lacked it.
* Exposure to OutSystems Developer Cloud (ODC).
* Experience supporting a geographically distributed user base across time zones.



  





**How we'll measure success:** 



* Our environments are stable, and unplanned downtime is rare and short.
* Deployments are routine and low\-drama, following a consistent ALM process.
* Recurring manual tasks reduce over time because they have been automated away.
* Platform documentation is current enough that a colleague can pick up an incident without you.

 The successful candidate will provide second\-level support for a wide range of hardware, software, identity, collaboration, and endpoint management technologies. Working closely with the Service Desk, Infrastructure, Security, and other Global IT teams, the Remote Services Specialist is responsible for resolving complex technical issues, managing user access and device lifecycles, maintaining technology compliance, and ensuring a seamless end\-user experience.
